baseline_verification.overlap: Validated historical observations retained from March 28 through September 14; no extrapolation.

lighter_event_coverage.unit: Parent transaction coverage, not gas coverage

coverage_limits.all_products: Unequal lower-bound coverage of selected Ethereum-side populations, not exhaustive footprints or native-chain gas.
coverage_limits.uniswap: Selected Ethereum routers, liquidity entrypoints and approvals; not Uniswap on other chains. Unknown, bridge and utility-only commands in the latest Universal Router are excluded.
coverage_limits.lighter: Primary instance only, excluding Lighter on Robinhood and unresolved wrappers. Parent-transaction coverage is not gas coverage.
coverage_limits.aave: Direct reviewed V2 and V3 pool methods; flash loans, V4 and wider callback-bearing or aggregator routes excluded.
coverage_limits.compound: Direct reviewed Comet USDC, WETH and USDT market methods; other deployments and routers excluded.
coverage_limits.morpho: Direct Morpho Blue methods, with empty callback data where applicable; vault wrappers and nonempty callbacks excluded.
coverage_limits.curve: Selected Ethereum non-lending ERC20 legacy pools from the official registry. Factory-wide pools, routers, underlying lending routes and native-ETH callbacks excluded.
coverage_limits.lido: Selected stETH/wstETH, withdrawal-request and oracle contracts. Token transfers included; unverified native-ETH withdrawal claims and wider staking modules excluded.
coverage_limits.etherfi: Selected LiquidityPool, eETH/weETH, withdrawal and oracle contracts. Only reviewed methods and token transfers included; wider deployments and callbacks excluded.
coverage_limits.ethena: Selected Ethereum USDe/sUSDe and ENA/sENA token and staking contracts, with reviewed methods. Aggregator routes and arbitrary callbacks excluded.
coverage_limits.sky: Selected Maker/Sky DAI/USDS/SKY, savings and migration contracts. Wider vault, auction and governance deployments excluded.
coverage_limits.aztecnetwork: Current v5 and previous v4 rollup contracts and selected operator, governance and deposit methods. Earlier Ignition deployments, legacy zk.money, arbitrary execution and unresolved routes excluded.
coverage_limits.starknet: Direct state updates and selected bridges; shared SHARP proof transactions excluded without proportional allocation.
coverage_limits.zksync2: Identified direct-chain settlement and bridges; shared Gateway proofs and settlement excluded.
coverage_limits.hyperliquid: Ethereum-side CCTP, Across, Wormhole and DLN routes for Hyperliquid/HyperEVM. Native Hyperliquid execution and its Arbitrum bridge excluded; no allocation of Arbitrum settlement.
coverage_limits.polygon: Polygon PoS checkpoints, reviewed staking and deposits, plus decoded bridges. Sidechain grouped with other non-L2 chains; unverified exits and arbitrary state messages excluded.
coverage_limits.edge: Ethereum-side bridge activity only. EDGE is an L3 settling via Arbitrum, excluded from both synthetic group subtotals.
coverage_limits.other_chains: Selected dedicated contracts, sender-specific inboxes and/or decoded chain-specific shared bridges, as listed per source. A chain with only bridge coverage is not assigned hypothetical settlement gas.
coverage_limits.shared_bridges: CCTP, Across, Wormhole and DLN: require a known source/destination chain and reviewed method. Incoming authenticated token-only routes included; mixed settlements, shared fills and arbitrary L1 callbacks excluded.

synthetic_rows.location: Primary comparison table only; never exported observations
synthetic_rows.all_l2_rollups: Covered L2s with Ethereum data availability at snapshot end
synthetic_rows.all_l2_non_rollups: Covered L2s with external data availability at snapshot end
synthetic_rows.all_alt: Covered non-L2 chains, including Polygon PoS
synthetic_rows.excluded: EDGE (L3) from every subtotal; unclassified Codex from both L2 subtotals
synthetic_rows.history_policy: Every selected-period observation stays with its chain’s end-of-snapshot cohort. The totals do not measure gas consumed only while that chain operated under its current architecture. In particular, Mantle and Nova migrated during the six-month observation window.
synthetic_rows.overlap: Subtotals overlap their members. Do not sum all comparison rows.

raw_data_note: Compact aggregate responses, dated baseline evidence and verification records are bundled. Transaction receipt CSVs are preserved in a separate archive, indexed by filename, checksum and population coverage in receipt-index.json; they are not included in this site or source repository. Full original provider page corpora are preserved separately.

receipt_archive.note: Preserved separately. Receipt CSVs are absent from the site and source repository.
